search_filters_learned: Canonical issue/task must be open and current.
Verify funding or payer evidence at canonical source, not a mirror.
Read comments/bids before build; reject maintainer-confirmed competing worker unless economics justify race.
Do not start substantial work until claim and submission paths are verified writable.
For agent-native marketplaces, distinguish API quality from live funded demand quality.
A tiny first paid task is worthwhile when it proves the complete execution and payout chain.
Do not assume a documented pre-funded/free claim path actually works: test the on-chain/platform settlement step.
When two independent bounties fail through the same platform signer and escrow operation, classify the rail as platform-blocked rather than retrying or sending funds.
Never compensate for a marketplace's underfunded internal signer by sending external funds unless that is an explicit normal user-side requirement and economics justify it.

latest_scan.material_learning: Transport, authentication, account creation, API-key creation and wallet creation are proven. The next missing functionality is not ours: Clawlancer's escrow signer lacks enough ETH to create escrow. Two separate active bounties reproduced the same failure.

next_action.instruction: Stop retrying Clawlancer until platform-side gas funding is repaired. Preserve the successful Taskman identity and credentials locally. Search for the next smallest funded opportunity on a rail where claim, delivery and payout can be executed now; prioritize proving one complete accepted payment over headline bounty size.
